Therefore the inner sum telescopes into a geometric series:

$$\sum_{k=1}^{\infty} 2^{-\lfloor 101k/j \rfloor} = \frac{1}{1 - 2^{-101}} \sum_{k=1}^{j} 2^{-\lfloor 101k/j \rfloor}.$$

Hence

$$S = \frac{2^{101}}{2^{101} - 1} \sum_{j=1}^{100} \sum_{k=1}^{j} 2^{-\lfloor 101k/j \rfloor}.$$
